response.justification: While Bogdan is a highly experienced polyglot engineer with a strong background in full-stack development, microservices, and technical community building, he lacks the highly specialized domain expertise required for this Principal-level position. The core focus of this role is architecting enterprise-scale growth and experimentation systems, but his resume shows no evidence of experience with feature-flagging systems, A/B testing frameworks, statistical bias detection, or large-scale telemetry foundations.
strengths: Over 15 years of polyglot software engineering experience across a diverse stack (JS/TS, Node.js, DLang, C/C++, Java).
Proven capability to build high-throughput systems, such as handling millions of requests per second at Dunnhumby.
Demonstrated technical leadership, open-source stewardship (GISCollective), and recent experience with AI-agent infrastructure.
concerns: Zero demonstrated experience building or managing experimentation platforms, A/B testing, or feature-flagging systems.
Lacks evidence of the high data aptitude, telemetry, and statistical analysis experience required for this specific role.
No proven track record operating at a Principal (IC6) level driving multi-workstream enterprise growth strategies.
